headline: Seasonal tax-season ramp drives sharp profit growth
summary_short: Intuit's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $8.56B (+10.4% y/y) and net income was $3.06B (+8.7% y/y), with diluted EPS of $11.09 (+10.7% y/y); the q/q comparisons for revenue, net income, operating income, and EPS render flat because of a shard data artifact, not genuine sequential flatness.
summary_long: Revenue was $8.56B, up 10.4% y/y. Gross profit was $7.18B, up 99.1% q/q and 9.5% y/y; EBIT was $4.12B, up 344.1% q/q and 9.7% y/y — both reflecting Intuit's seasonal Q1-to-Q2 tax-season ramp. EBITDA was $4.33B, up 281.0% q/q and 9.5% y/y. Net income was $3.06B, up 8.7% y/y. Diluted EPS was $11.09, up 10.7% y/y; basic EPS was $11.10, up 10.0% y/y.
